decisionSummary: The Aug 21 dev-publish v26/2.0.33 source is canonical. It is the direct forward fix from the reviewed rich miniPaint/Jinn peer line: it retains the unavailable-sandbox-mkdir repair, fixes the real Sandstorm resume path so a fresh Paint grain defaults explicitly to minipaint, and locks every runtime dependency required for byte-reproducible SPK construction. It retains scoped read-only GrainContext integration for Jinn, the full PowerBox-gated image editor, and candidate-bound metadata aligned with the signed Bureau Paint identity. Main remains its reviewed stable ancestor; the divergent metadata and historical publish/codex refs are older package or release lines with no newer runnable Paint source.
